---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for RedKit
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**

What you want to happen. For module proposals, include: category (recon / vuln_scan / auth / other), what it tests, detection logic, and expected severities.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Other tools or approaches, and why they don't fit.

**Authorized-use check**

Does this feature remain strictly within authorized-testing use (no DoS, no mass targeting, no unauthorized access capability)? Features that cannot answer yes will be declined.

**Additional context**

Any other context, screenshots, or references.
